summary: Mountain Lake Acquisition Corp. II (MLAC II), a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting that exclusivity under its non-binding letter of intent with Terra Quantum AG has expired. The SPAC may now pursue discussions with other targets. No definitive terms, price, or timeline have been disclosed. The filing signals a potential shift in business combination efforts. Investors should monitor for a new target announcement or liquidation if no deal is reached before the deadline.
